content.thinking: Builds cleanly with -Wall -Wextra. Now test the native fixtures.

arguments.command: cd /workspace && for f in examples/*.in.native; do o=${f/.in./.out.}; echo "=== $f"; ./tmp/engine < $f > /tmp/nout.txt 2>/tmp/nerr.txt; echo "rc=$?"; cat /tmp/nerr.txt; if diff <(tr -s ' \n' ' ' < /tmp/nout.txt) <(tr -s ' \n' ' ' < $o) >/dev/null; then echo MATCH; else echo DIFF; head -c 400 /tmp/nout.txt; echo; echo "--- exp"; head -c 400 $o; fi; done
